## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run generate` leaves no diff (generated artifacts current)
- [ ] Typecheck, lint, format, tests, build, and budget check pass locally
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior (including error paths)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under _Unreleased_ (user-visible changes)
- [ ] No secret material anywhere in the diff
- [ ] Docs updated where behavior changed (README / docs/)
